a.lede: The company behind the Claude chatbot will become one of the most valuable firms in the world.
a.title: Anthropic raises $81bn in record-breaking stock market debut

b.lede: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
b.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
